approved_removals.core:default: Replaced broad umbrella with explicit required core plugins (core:app:default, core:event:default, core:window:default, core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom) so unused menu/image/resources/tray/path and devtools are excluded.
approved_removals.core:image:default: Not used by frontend IPC (@tauri-apps/api/image has 0 imports; icons handled by backend RPCs and standard HTML img).
approved_removals.core:menu:default: Not used by frontend IPC (@tauri-apps/api/menu has 0 imports; app menus are managed natively in Rust).
approved_removals.core:path:default: Not used by frontend IPC (@tauri-apps/api/path has 0 imports; filesystem paths handled on backend).
approved_removals.core:resources:default: Not used by frontend IPC (Resource has 0 imports; resource lifecycle managed natively on backend).
approved_removals.core:tray:default: Not used by frontend IPC (@tauri-apps/api/tray has 0 imports).
approved_removals.core:webview:default: Replaced umbrella with explicit core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom in release; internal_toggle_devtools is debug-only and unused webview getters removed.
approved_removals.core:webview:allow-internal-toggle-devto: Moved exclusively to debug-only capabilities/devtools.json generated by build.rs; excluded from release profile.
approved_removals.core:window:allow-create: Not used by frontend IPC (secondary/auth windows are created natively in Rust).
approved_removals.fs:allow-exists: Not used by frontend JS (only fs:allow-read-file with fs:scope is used).
approved_removals.fs:allow-read-dir: Not used by frontend JS (directory listing is handled by backend files plugin).
approved_removals.fs:allow-read-text-file: Not used by frontend JS (only binary fs:allow-read-file is used).
approved_removals.os:allow-hostname: Not used by frontend JS; removed unnecessary hostname access (os:default retains platform/version/os-type/arch/locale).
approved_removals.window-state:default: Replaced umbrella with explicit window-state:allow-save-window-state; restoration runs natively on backend.
approved_removals.window-state:allow-restore-state: Window state restoration runs natively in Rust setup rather than via frontend IPC.
